digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center backend transport layer
propositions: The DC transport lacks twelve methods that the reconciler core requires, causing both crashes (set_entity_property at one site) and silent degradation (seven members swallowed by try/catch blocks at all call sites).

Absence at call sites produces silent convergence while corruption proceeds — a DC deployment appears to sync while missing comments, links, parents, and property changes, which is worse than crashing.
The port declares only six members but the core reaches for twenty-one distinct transport methods, leaving the gap invisible until a live writing pass exercises an unguarded call.
Reporter field syncs infinitely on DC because inbound_fields._identity_of reads accountId only, yielding None for DC names, so the differ re-emits the mutation after every successful write.
Epic/parent links require branching on parent type (epic uses add_issues_to_epic with agile_rest_path=greenhopper; sub-tasks use fields.parent) rather than a single naive parent write.

Seven of the twelve absent members have exception handlers at every call site that swallow AttributeError, making the failures invisible and turning fix verification from 'no crash' into 'member provably present'.
